rows.text: • Cardinal Health raises fiscal year 2027 non-GAAP EPS guidance 2 to $12.80 to $13.00, 17% to 19% growth 3 from its FY26 ex-tariff refund baseline and 14% to 15% growth from reported FY26 results
3 Growth rates for fiscal year 2027 guidance based upon adjusted fiscal year 2026 non-GAAP diluted EPS of $10.95, which excludes the fiscal year 2026 benefit from IEEPA tariff refund.
• Cardinal Health provides fiscal year 2027 non-GAAP EPS guidance 2 of 13% to 15% growth 3 ($12.40 to $12.60), above the Company's long-term EPS guidance
